answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 159504 Country: India Title: When we visit grave of our relatives do they really see us or feel us? Question: (1) When we visit grave of our relatives do they really see us or feel us? (2) If daughter in law had done some nakadri when his father in law was alive so now after his death how she should seek mafi from marhumin? (3) While sending isal-e-sawab we should make niyat for specially for one person for whom we want to send or it is better to send it to all who are dead from Adam (AS)? Answer ID: 159504 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 707/701/B=8/1439) (1) Yes, by the order of Allah they feel and reply our salam as well. (2) Do istighfar for them extensively. (3) It is correct if you do isal-e-sawab for any of them or even for the whole Ummah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
